## DPStyleARWebLive.render() method

Render and apply the current StyleAR virtual try-on output. Call this after updating the item and mask ROI based on processing results. This method finalizes the rendering pass by applying all StyleAR outputs (item rendering and mask ROI) so the latest virtual try-on result is reflected in the current frame.

**Signature:**

```typescript
render(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that resolves when rendering has been applied.
